I submitted a portfolio that holds every signal with a training Sharpe above 0.3. Each signal is weighted by its training Sharpe divided by its volatility, and the rest get zero weight. It scored a training Sharpe of 1.36 and a validation Sharpe of 0.21. Almost none of the 423 signals has real out-of-sample edge, since the best single-signal training Sharpe was only about 0.45, so the training result is mostly overfit and I'd expect little from it beyond the validation figure.

I chose the portfolio from training data alone and only used `bt.backtest` to compare four weighting schemes and nine family-level groups. The 0.21 is the best of the four weighting schemes I tried, so it is somewhat flattered by that choice.
